title: T‑Mobile Responding to Malibu Wildfires
summary: As wildfires threaten communities in Malibu, T‑Mobile teams are actively responding to network impacts, deploying resources and coordinating with local
body_markdown:
As wildfires threaten communities in Malibu, T‑Mobile teams are actively responding to network impacts, deploying[resources](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/disaster-definitions) and coordinating with local[agencies](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/community/how-t-mobile-shows-up-for-first-responders-across-america) to help keep customers and first responders connected.


We’re closely monitoring conditions and will continue adapting our response as the situation evolves.


> Our hearts are with everyone in Malibu facing wildfires and evacuations, and with the firefighters and emergency crews working to keep communities safe.[@TMobile](https://x.com/TMobile?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw) teams are actively responding to changing conditions, with generators already deployed to help maintain connectivity…[pic.twitter.com/NrJ0O5dgkk](https://t.co/NrJ0O5dgkk)
>
>
> — T-Mobile Newsroom (@tmobilenews)[October 16, 2026](https://x.com/tmobilenews/status/2110931611256770888?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)


To see the latest updates, visit the the company’s[Emergency Response hub](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/emergency-response) and follow @TMobileNews on X and Instagram.
